title: CAMERA/LOOK: DV 16mm tape-camcorder vlog aesthetic, POV alternating between…
content:
CAMERA/LOOK: DV 16mm tape-camcorder vlog aesthetic, POV alternating between CHASE and PARTNER, sometimes propped on gym equipment. Handheld shake, imperfect framing, delayed focus, clumsy zooms, occasional face cutoffs. Soft blurry tape texture, faint noise, bloomed warm highlights, flickering exposure, muted contrast, realistic skin. Sweat and flushed faces intensify throughout. Camcorder never visible.

CHARACTERS:
CHASE: Korean idol, 20s, long black high ponytail, expressive eyes, flushed cheeks, slim athletic build. Lightweight modest summer workout top + high-waisted leggings/knee-length shorts, sneakers.
PARTNER: Korean woman, 20s, similar age/energy, tied-back hair, athletic build, lightweight modest athletic outfit, sneakers. No jewelry. Both visibly sweaty.

SETTING: Hot summer gym with broken AC, warm harsh lighting, fan blowing warm air, open door, racks, mats, mirrors, water bottles.

30s STORYBOARD — 15 CUTS:

1. 0–2s: Propped camera. Both enter fanning themselves. CHASE: “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
2. 2–4s: Handheld. PARTNER points at broken AC: “The AC's been out since this morning.”
3. 4–6s: At rack, CHASE loads bar, PARTNER spots. “Let’s just push through it.”
4. 6–8s: Propped shot. CHASE lifts while PARTNER spots.
5. 8–9.5s: Macro hands gripping sweaty bar, sweat dripping. Ambient sound.
6. 9.5–11.5s: PARTNER lifts, CHASE spots: “You've got it, come on!”
7. 11.5–13.5s: Both catch breath, fan shirts, laugh. PARTNER: “Okay, I'm already soaked.”
8. 13.5–15.5s: Walking to mats with water. CHASE: “Water break, mandatory.”
9. 15.5–17.5s: Propped shot. Both drink, sigh, laugh.
10. 17.5–19.5s: Both plank competitively. PARTNER: “Who’s giving up first?”
11. 19.5–21.5s: Straining, sweat dripping. CHASE: “Not—me—”
12. 21.5–23.5s: Macro sweat hitting mat, heavy breathing.
13. 23.5–25.5s: Both collapse laughing. PARTNER: “Okay, that's officially a tie.”
14. 25.5–27.5s: Sitting up, jokingly fanning each other with towels. CHASE: “This heat is actually insane.”
15. 27.5–30s: Arm’s-length selfie. Both sweaty, grinning, tired high-five. CHASE: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

TONE: Playful, sweaty, energetic gym vlog. Competitive but supportive banter, genuine exhaustion and laughter. Heat and sweat visibly escalate from beginning to end.

es.content:
CAMERA/LOOK: estética de vlog con camcorder DV de cinta 16mm, POV alternando entre CHASE y PARTNER, a veces apoyada sobre el equipo del gimnasio. Sacudidas de cámara en mano, encuadre imperfecto, enfoque tardío, zooms torpes, cortes ocasionales de rostros. Textura suave y borrosa de cinta, ruido tenue, altas luces cálidas y difuminadas, exposición parpadeante, contraste apagado, piel realista. El sudor y los rostros enrojecidos se intensifican a lo largo de la escena. La camcorder nunca es visible.

CHARACTERS:
CHASE: ídolo coreano, 20s, coleta alta larga negra, ojos expresivos, mejillas sonrojadas, complexión delgada y atlética. Top de entrenamiento veraniego ligero y modesto + leggings de cintura alta/shorts hasta la rodilla, zapatillas.
PARTNER: mujer coreana, 20s, edad/energía similar, cabello recogido hacia atrás, complexión atlética, conjunto deportivo ligero y modesto, zapatillas. Sin joyas. Ambas visiblemente sudadas.

SETTING: Gimnasio caluroso de verano con el aire acondicionado averiado, iluminación cálida y dura, ventilador soplando aire caliente, puerta abierta, racks, colchonetas, espejos, botellas de agua.

STORYBOARD DE 30s — 15 CORTES:

1. 0–2s: Cámara apoyada. Ambas entran abanicándose. CHASE: “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
2. 2–4s: Cámara en mano. PARTNER señala el aire acondicionado averiado: “The AC's been out since this morning.”
3. 4–6s: Junto al rack, CHASE carga la barra, PARTNER hace de spotter. “Let’s just push through it.”
4. 6–8s: Toma apoyada. CHASE levanta mientras PARTNER hace de spotter.
5. 8–9.5s: Macro de manos agarrando la barra sudada, el sudor gotea. Sonido ambiente.
6. 9.5–11.5s: PARTNER levanta, CHASE hace de spotter: “You've got it, come on!”
7. 11.5–13.5s: Ambas recuperan el aliento, se abanican con las camisetas, ríen. PARTNER: “Okay, I'm already soaked.”
8. 13.5–15.5s: Caminando hacia las colchonetas con agua. CHASE: “Water break, mandatory.”
9. 15.5–17.5s: Toma apoyada. Ambas beben, suspiran, ríen.
10. 17.5–19.5s: Ambas hacen plank compitiendo. PARTNER: “Who’s giving up first?”
11. 19.5–21.5s: Esfuerzo visible, sudor goteando. CHASE: “Not—me—”
12. 21.5–23.5s: Macro de sudor cayendo sobre la colchoneta, respiración pesada.
13. 23.5–25.5s: Ambas se desploman riendo. PARTNER: “Okay, that's officially a tie.”
14. 25.5–27.5s: Sentadas, se abanicen juguetonamente con toallas. CHASE: “This heat is actually insane.”
15. 27.5–30s: Selfie a la distancia del brazo. Ambas sudadas, sonriendo, chocan la mano cansadas. CHASE: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

TONE: Vlog de gimnasio juguetón, sudado y enérgico. Broma competitiva pero de apoyo, agotamiento genuino y risas. El calor y el sudor aumentan visiblemente del principio al final.

fr.content:
CAMÉRA/LOOK : esthétique vlog en DV 16mm façon caméscope à cassette, POV alternant entre CHASE et PARTNER, parfois posé sur du matériel de gym. Tremblements à la main, cadrage imparfait, mise au point retardée, zooms maladroits, visages parfois coupés. Texture douce et floue de cassette, léger bruit, hautes lumières chaudes et éclatées, exposition qui scintille, contraste atténué, peau réaliste. La sueur et les visages rougis s’intensifient au fil de la vidéo. Le caméscope n’est jamais visible.

PERSONNAGES :
CHASE : idole coréenne, vingtaine, longue queue-de-cheval noire, regard expressif, joues rougies, silhouette mince et athlétique. Haut d’entraînement d’été léger et modeste + leggings taille haute/shorts jusqu’aux genoux, baskets.
PARTNER : femme coréenne, vingtaine, âge/énergie similaires, cheveux attachés, silhouette athlétique, tenue de sport légère et modeste, baskets. Aucun bijou. Les deux sont visiblement en sueur.

DÉCOR : Salle de sport en été, climatisation en panne, éclairage chaud et dur, ventilateur soufflant de l’air chaud, porte ouverte, racks, tapis, miroirs, bouteilles d’eau.

STORYBOARD 30 s — 15 PLANS :

1. 0–2 s : Caméra posée. Les deux entrent en s’éventant. CHASE : “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
2. 2–4 s : À la main. PARTNER montre la clim cassée : “The AC's been out since this morning.”
3. 4–6 s : Près du rack, CHASE charge la barre, PARTNER assure la parade. “Let’s just push through it.”
4. 6–8 s : Plan posé. CHASE soulève pendant que PARTNER assure la parade.
5. 8–9,5 s : Gros plan sur les mains agrippant la barre moite, la sueur qui goutte. Son d’ambiance.
6. 9,5–11,5 s : PARTNER soulève, CHASE assure la parade : “You've got it, come on!”
7. 11,5–13,5 s : Les deux reprennent leur souffle, s’éventent avec leurs shirts, rient. PARTNER : “Okay, I'm already soaked.”
8. 13,5–15,5 s : Elles marchent vers les tapis avec de l’eau. CHASE : “Water break, mandatory.”
9. 15,5–17,5 s : Plan posé. Les deux boivent, soupirent, rient.
10. 17,5–19,5 s : Les deux font la planche en mode compétition. PARTNER : “Who’s giving up first?”
11. 19,5–21,5 s : Effort intense, sueur qui coule. CHASE : “Not—me—”
12. 21,5–23,5 s : Gros plan sur la sueur qui tombe sur le tapis, respiration lourde.
13. 23,5–25,5 s : Les deux s’effondrent en riant. PARTNER : “Okay, that's officially a tie.”
14. 25,5–27,5 s : Assises, elles s’éventent mutuellement avec des serviettes en plaisantant. CHASE : “This heat is actually insane.”
15. 27,5–30 s : Selfie à bout de bras. Les deux, en sueur, souriantes, se tapent dans la main, épuisées. CHASE : “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

TON : Vlog de salle de sport ludique, moite et énergique. Échanges compétitifs mais bienveillants, vraie fatigue et rires. La chaleur et la sueur s’intensifient visiblement du début à la fin.

ja.content:
CAMERA/LOOK: DV 16mmのテープ式ビデオカメラ風のvlog aesthetic。POVはCHASEとPARTNERの間で交互に切り替わり、時々ジム器具の上に置かれている。手持ちの揺れ、完璧ではないフレーミング、遅れ気味のフォーカス、不器用なズーム、たまに顔がフレームアウトする。柔らかくぼやけたテープ質感、かすかなノイズ、暖色のハイライトのにじみ、ちらつく露出、抑えめのコントラスト、リアルな肌感。汗と赤らんだ顔が徐々に強調されていく。ビデオカメラ本体は映らない。

CHARACTERS:
CHASE: 韓国のアイドル、20代、長い黒髪のハイポニーテール、表情豊かな目、赤みのある頬、細身でアスレチックな体型。軽量で控えめな夏用ワークアウトトップ＋ハイウエストのレギンス／膝丈ショーツ、スニーカー。
PARTNER: 韓国人女性、20代、同年代・同じくらいのエネルギー、後ろでまとめた髪、アスレチックな体型、軽量で控えめなアスレチックウェア、スニーカー。アクセサリーなし。どちらも目に見えて汗をかいている。

SETTING: ACが壊れている暑い夏のジム。暖かく強い照明、温風を送る扇風機、開いたドア、ラック、マット、鏡、水筒。

30秒のSTORYBOARD — 15カット:

1. 0–2s: 置きカメラ。2人とも入ってきて、暑さにあおぎながら登場。CHASE: “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
2. 2–4s: 手持ち。PARTNERが壊れたACを指さす: “The AC's been out since this morning.”
3. 4–6s: ラックの前で、CHASEがバーをセットし、PARTNERがスポットする。 “Let’s just push through it.”
4. 6–8s: 置きショット。CHASEがリフトし、PARTNERがスポットする。
5. 8–9.5s: 汗で濡れたバーを握る手のマクロ。汗が滴る。環境音。
6. 9.5–11.5s: PARTNERがリフトし、CHASEがスポット: “You've got it, come on!”
7. 11.5–13.5s: 2人とも息を整え、シャツをあおぎ、笑う。PARTNER: “Okay, I'm already soaked.”
8. 13.5–15.5s: 水を持ってマットへ歩く。CHASE: “Water break, mandatory.”
9. 15.5–17.5s: 置きショット。2人とも水を飲み、ため息をつき、笑う。
10. 17.5–19.5s: 2人で競うようにプランク。PARTNER: “Who’s giving up first?”
11. 19.5–21.5s: きつそうに耐え、汗が滴る。CHASE: “Not—me—”
12. 21.5–23.5s: 汗がマットに落ちるマクロ。荒い呼吸。
13. 23.5–25.5s: 2人とも笑いながら倒れ込む。PARTNER: “Okay, that's officially a tie.”
14. 25.5–27.5s: 起き上がって、タオルでふざけて互いをあおぐ。CHASE: “This heat is actually insane.”
15. 27.5–30s: 腕を伸ばしたセルフィー。2人とも汗だくで、笑顔、疲れたハイタッチ。CHASE: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

TONE: ふざけた感じで、汗だくで、エネルギッシュなジムvlog。競争心はあるけれど支え合う掛け合い、本物の疲労感と笑い。暑さと汗が最初から最後まで目に見えて増していく。

ko.content:
CAMERA/LOOK: DV 16mm 테이프 캠코더 vlog aesthetic, POV는 CHASE와 PARTNER 사이를 번갈아 가며 전환, 때로는 gym equipment 위에 올려둔 구도. 핸드헬드 흔들림, 불완전한 프레이밍, 지연되는 초점, 어설픈 줌인/줌아웃, 가끔 얼굴이 잘리는 컷. 부드럽고 흐릿한 테이프 질감, 은은한 노이즈, 번지는 따뜻한 하이라이트, 깜빡이는 노출, 절제된 대비, 현실적인 피부 표현. 땀과 달아오른 얼굴이 진행될수록 더 강해짐. 캠코더는 절대 보이지 않음.

CHARACTERS:
CHASE: 한국 아이돌, 20대, 긴 검은색 하이 포니테일, 표정이 풍부한 눈, 달아오른 볼, 슬림한 운동 체형. 가벼운, 단정한 여름 운동 상의 + 하이웨이스트 레깅스/무릎 길이 쇼츠, 스니커즈.
PARTNER: 한국 여성, 20대, 비슷한 나이와 에너지, 묶은 머리, 운동 체형, 가벼운 단정한 운동복, 스니커즈. 액세서리 없음. 둘 다 땀이 눈에 띄게 많음.

SETTING: 에어컨이 고장 난 더운 여름 헬스장, 따뜻하고 강한 조명, 따뜻한 바람을 내뿜는 선풍기, 열린 문, 랙, 매트, 거울, 물병들.

30s STORYBOARD — 15 CUTS:

1. 0–2s: 카메라를 올려둔 구도. 둘이 들어오며 부채질한다. CHASE: “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
2. 2–4s: 핸드헬드. PARTNER가 고장 난 에어컨을 가리킨다: “The AC's been out since this morning.”
3. 4–6s: 랙 앞에서 CHASE가 바를 세팅하고, PARTNER가 스팟한다. “Let’s just push through it.”
4. 6–8s: 올려둔 카메라 샷. CHASE가 리프팅하고 PARTNER가 스팟한다.
5. 8–9.5s: 땀에 젖은 바를 쥔 손의 매크로, 땀이 떨어진다. 주변 소리.
6. 9.5–11.5s: PARTNER가 리프팅하고 CHASE가 스팟한다: “You've got it, come on!”
7. 11.5–13.5s: 둘 다 숨을 고르며 셔츠를 부채질하고 웃는다. PARTNER: “Okay, I'm already soaked.”
8. 13.5–15.5s: 물을 들고 매트 쪽으로 걸어간다. CHASE: “Water break, mandatory.”
9. 15.5–17.5s: 카메라를 올려둔 구도. 둘이 물을 마시고, 한숨 쉬고, 웃는다.
10. 17.5–19.5s: 둘이 경쟁하듯 플랭크를 한다. PARTNER: “Who’s giving up first?”
11. 19.5–21.5s: 힘겨워하며 땀이 떨어진다. CHASE: “Not—me—”
12. 21.5–23.5s: 매트 위로 떨어지는 땀의 매크로, 거친 호흡.
13. 23.5–25.5s: 둘 다 웃으며 쓰러진다. PARTNER: “Okay, that's officially a tie.”
14. 25.5–27.5s: 일어나 앉아, 수건으로 서로를 장난스럽게 부채질한다. CHASE: “This heat is actually insane.”
15. 27.5–30s: 팔 길이 셀피. 둘 다 땀에 젖어 있고, 웃고 있으며, 지친 채 하이파이브한다. CHASE: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

TONE: 장난스럽고, 땀 범벅이고, 에너지 넘치는 gym vlog. 경쟁적이지만 서로를 응원하는 티키타카, 진짜 같은 피로와 웃음. 시작부터 끝까지 더위와 땀이 눈에 띄게 심해짐.

pt.content:
CAMERA/LOOK: estética de vlog em fita DV 16mm, POV alternando entre CHASE e PARTNER, às vezes apoiada em equipamentos de academia. Tremor de câmera na mão, enquadramento imperfeito, foco atrasado, zooms desajeitados, cortes ocasionais no rosto. Textura suave e borrada de fita, leve ruído, highlights quentes estourados, exposição piscando, contraste suave, pele realista. O suor e os rostos corados se intensificam ao longo do vídeo. A filmadora nunca aparece.

PERSONAGENS:
CHASE: idol coreana, 20 e poucos anos, rabo de cavalo alto preto e longo, olhos expressivos, bochechas coradas, corpo esguio e atlético. Top de treino de verão leve e modesto + legging de cintura alta/shorts até o joelho, tênis.
PARTNER: mulher coreana, 20 e poucos anos, idade/energia semelhantes, cabelo preso, corpo atlético, roupa esportiva leve e modesta, tênis. Sem joias. Ambas visivelmente suadas.

CENÁRIO: academia quente de verão com ar-condicionado quebrado, iluminação quente e forte, ventilador soprando ar quente, porta aberta, racks, colchonetes, espelhos, garrafas de água.

STORYBOARD DE 30s — 15 CORTES:

1. 0–2s: Câmera apoiada. As duas entram se abanando. CHASE: “Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
2. 2–4s: Na mão. PARTNER aponta para o ar-condicionado quebrado: “The AC's been out since this morning.”
3. 4–6s: No rack, CHASE coloca a barra, PARTNER faz a segurança. “Let’s just push through it.”
4. 6–8s: Plano apoiado. CHASE levanta enquanto PARTNER faz a segurança.
5. 8–9.5s: Macro das mãos segurando a barra suada, suor pingando. Som ambiente.
6. 9.5–11.5s: PARTNER levanta, CHASE faz a segurança: “You've got it, come on!”
7. 11.5–13.5s: As duas recuperam o fôlego, se abanam com as camisetas, riem. PARTNER: “Okay, I'm already soaked.”
8. 13.5–15.5s: Indo para os colchonetes com água. CHASE: “Water break, mandatory.”
9. 15.5–17.5s: Plano apoiado. As duas bebem água, suspiram, riem.
10. 17.5–19.5s: As duas fazem prancha de forma competitiva. PARTNER: “Who’s giving up first?”
11. 19.5–21.5s: Fazendo força, suor pingando. CHASE: “Not—me—”
12. 21.5–23.5s: Macro do suor caindo no colchonete, respiração pesada.
13. 23.5–25.5s: As duas desabam rindo. PARTNER: “Okay, that's officially a tie.”
14. 25.5–27.5s: Sentadas, se abanando uma à outra de brincadeira com toalhas. CHASE: “This heat is actually insane.”
15. 27.5–30s: Selfie com o braço estendido. As duas suadas, sorrindo, dão um high-five cansado. CHASE: “Okay, we survived — see you guys!”

TONE: Vlog de academia divertido, suado e energético. Troca de provocações competitiva, mas solidária, exaustão genuína e risadas. O calor e o suor aumentam visivelmente do começo ao fim.

zh.content:
CAMERA/LOOK：DV 16mm 录像机 vlog 美学，POV 在 CHASE 和 PARTNER 之间交替，有时架在健身器械上。手持抖动、构图不完美、对焦延迟、笨拙的变焦、偶尔脸部被切掉。柔和模糊的磁带质感、轻微噪点、泛光的暖色高光、闪烁的曝光、低饱和对比度、真实皮肤质感。随着进程推进，汗水和泛红的脸颊愈发明显。录像机始终不可见。

CHARACTERS：
CHASE：韩国偶像，20多岁，黑色长高马尾，表情丰富的眼睛，泛红脸颊，纤细运动型身材。轻薄、得体的夏季训练上衣 + 高腰紧身裤/及膝短裤，运动鞋。
PARTNER：韩国女性，20多岁，年龄/活力相近，扎起的头发，运动型身材，轻薄、得体的运动服，运动鞋。无首饰。两人都明显出汗。

SETTING：炎热的夏季健身房，空调坏了，灯光温暖而刺眼，风扇吹出热风，门敞开，器械架、垫子、镜子、水瓶随处可见。

30秒分镜脚本 — 15个镜头：

1. 0–2s：架好的镜头。两人一边扇风一边进场。CHASE：“Okay, it is way too hot in here today.”
2. 2–4s：手持。PARTNER 指向坏掉的空调：“The AC's been out since this morning.”
3. 4–6s：在器械架旁，CHASE 装上杠铃，PARTNER 负责保护。 “Let’s just push through it.”
4. 6–8s：架好的镜头。CHASE 举起，PARTNER 负责保护。
5. 8–9.5s：手部特写，汗湿的手握住杠铃，汗水滴落。环境音。
6. 9.5–11.5s：PARTNER 举起，CHASE 负责保护：“You've got it, come on!”
7. 11.5–13.5s：两人喘着气，扇着衣服，笑起来。PARTNER：“Okay, I'm already soaked.”
8. 13.5–15.5s：拿着水走向垫子。CHASE：“Water break, mandatory.”
9. 15.5–17.5s：架好的镜头。两人喝水、叹气、笑。
10. 17.5–19.5s：两人竞争性地做平板支撑。PARTNER：“Who’s giving up first?”
11. 19.5–21.5s：用力坚持，汗水滴落。CHASE：“Not—me—”
12. 21.5–23.5s：汗水滴到垫子上的特写，沉重呼吸声。
